views.title: The platform
views.text: Two apps call one gateway. Four services sit behind it, and everything downstream hangs off events.

views.title: One checkout, end to end
views.text: The request goes from the web app through the gateway to Orders and Payments, then out to Stripe. Events flow to the bus in the background.
views.notes: The packet follows the arrows as the layout routed them. P pauses it.
